test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 24 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following statement is related to Koeppen's ‘A’ type of climate?

options.text: Average temperature for all months is below 10°C
Average temperature of the coldest month is 18°C or higher
Possible evaporation is equal to precipitation

solution:
The correct answer is __**Average temperature of the coldest month is 18°C or higher**__ .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **Tropical Climate Characteristics:**

 
• Koeppen's "A" climates are defined by consistently high temperatures throughout the year.
 
• They are found in regions near the equator.
 
• The average temperature of the coldest month in "A" climates is above 18°C (64.4°F).
 
• These climates are marked by abundant rainfall, although the distribution of rainfall varies.
 
• There are three main subtypes of "A" climates: tropical rainforest (Af), tropical monsoon (Am), and tropical savanna (Aw).
 
• **Tropical Rainforest (Af):**
 
 
• Af climates experience consistent rainfall throughout the year, with no distinct dry season.
 
• These climates are typically found in equatorial regions with high humidity.
 
• Vegetation in Af climates is characterized by dense, evergreen rainforests.
 
 
 
• **Tropical Monsoon (Am):**
 
 
• Am climates have a distinct wet season, typically during the summer months, and a dry season.
 
• The wet season is characterized by heavy rainfall due to monsoon winds.
 
• These climates are often found along coastal regions influenced by monsoon circulations.
 
 
 
• **Tropical Savanna (Aw):**
 
 
• Aw climates have a distinct dry season, typically during the winter months, and a wet season during the summer.
 
• These climates are characterized by grasslands with scattered trees.
 
• The dry season can be prolonged and intense.
 
 
 
• **Geographical Distribution:**
 
 
• "A" climates are found in regions such as the Amazon basin, the Congo basin, Southeast Asia, and parts of Central America.
 
• They are also found in parts of India.
